text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, should I go with this one?
...Or maybe this one?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, Sweep-san. Are you reading?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, perfect timing.
What comes to mind when you think of awful-tasting herbs?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Awful-tasting herbs...?
Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing, I just felt like asking.
...So, what's your answer?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... In terms of sheer bitterness,
I suppose it would have to be senburi.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I see, senburi! That sounds perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Sweep-san, where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, according to Grandma's secret field guide,
senburi grows in sunny spots and has long, slender leaves...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Could you be searching for senburi?
Whatever for...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, the truth is—
I'm gonna play a prank on Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, a prank?! 
Please don't... You really shouldn't do that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm doing it! She made me eat vegetables the other day!
I'm definitely going to make her cry uncle!

—Oh? That sounds like an interesting conversation.
Who are you going to make cry uncle?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That mean dorm leader, of course!
I'm not gonna take this lying down!
'Mean dorm leader', is it... I see.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a-awawa...!
Sweep-san, stop, no more...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ I wonder what kind of face that dorm leader'll make
after drinking super bitter medicinal tea?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Maybe a face like this?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, what is that! That's hila... rious—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek~~~?! Why, why, why?!
Why is Fuji-san here...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do I do...?! Hey, you over there!
Think of an excuse for me!
choice_data_list: It was because she cares about your health, Fuji-san!
It was because she cares about your health, Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do I do...?! Hey, you over there!
Think of an excuse for me!
choice_data_list: It was because she cares about your health, Fuji-san!
It was because she cares about your health, Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, right! That's right!
I was looking for herbs out of concern for your health, Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, health-boosting herbs for me. 
How delightful. However—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It would be a waste for me to enjoy them all by myself.
Sweep, why don't we drink it together?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's healthy medicine, after all. If so, I'd love for you
to become healthy with me. You don't mind, do you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: W-Well... that is, um—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, where could that senburi be?
Ah... Could that be it over there?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way, you found it already?!
No, no, no! I'm not drinking it~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, everything is better when you enjoy it!
Come, let's brew it up and drink it together!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay!! I mean,
why are you so totally into this, anyway?!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If Sweep-san is a witch,
then Fuji-senpai is just like a wizard... indeed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
If you apologize honestly, I'll give you something nice.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really!?
Something nice... like what?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's a surprise for after you apologize.
Now, what will you do?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmph...... fine.
I just have to apologize, right? I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ......I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good job saying it. A good girl gets
a present. Follow me, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a "Nutrient-Packed Cake" loaded
with sweet, melt-in-your-mouth cream. Bon appétit!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yay! It's cake!♪
Ehehe, thanks for the food~♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even for me... thank you. I was curious about this cake
since it provides all the nutrients at once—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice? The secret to "nutrient-packed."
...Keep it a secret from Sweep, okay?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...The ingredients of this cake are mostly vegetables.
If Sweep-san is a witch,
then Fuji-senpai is just like a wizard... indeed.
